name: SkillCopilotAI
tagline: AI interview assistant for job seekers.
description: SkillCopilotAI is an AI interview assistant for job seekers. It is available as a desktop app for Mac and Windows. A 30-minute trial is available before a paid subscription; plans are US$89.90 monthly, US$179.70 quarterly, or US$346.80 annually (US$28.90/month billed annually). It is not a permanent free plan.
